_comment: Chipdb-completeness overlay for GW5A-25A IOLOGIC OREG / CE / IOBUF paths. These bits were DERIVED LOCALLY (not in upstream apicula's GW5A-25A chipdb) by running 61 Gowin micro-corpus builds via gw_sh.exe and per-pin localized feature pair-diff (codex methodology, job a62f21d0, 2026-05-21). When the predicate matches an encoded IOLOGIC cell at the listed ttyp+bel, the encoder unions these extra bits into the tile bitmap. The overlay is DORMANT when no IOLOGICO_EMPTY+HAS_REG cells exist (the nextpnr auto-IOBFF trigger that creates such cells was reverted 2026-05-21 after 3 HW failures on SDRAM-DQ; overlay remains as documented chipdb extension for future activation paths that don't break bidirectional IOB read direction). All extraction provenance: corpus path, source pins, evidence diff, target_delta cross-ref.
_status: EXTRACTED-BUT-DORMANT (no current trigger emits IOLOGICO_EMPTY+HAS_REG cells)
_derivation_methodology: 1) Build N obuf_direct/obuf_dff/obuf_dffce/iobuf_dff/iobuf_dff_oeff variants at M pins via Gowin EDA. 2) For each (template_base, template_with_feature) pair: diff the bits at the pin's local tile. 3) High-confidence attribution: bits added by the feature in >=2 pins of the same ttyp. 4) Cross-ref with target_delta_16dq.json scoreboard (Gowin EXP_HH bits OSS-baseline lacks).
_known_limitations: (a) Single-tile ttyps (274/385/396/401) cannot be cross-pin attributed; not in overlay. (b) Only IOLOGICA-side bits extracted; IOLOGICB analogous bits inferred via bel_pattern but not separately verified. (c) TREG (OE-register) predicates 'has_attr: TREG_OUTREGMODE' are INERT — apicula's encoder doesn't emit those attrs yet. (d) Overlay activated only when IOLOGICO_EMPTY cells exist in the netlist; current revertted nextpnr never emits such cells.
